caseName: Colo. Dep't of State v. Baca
caseNameFull: COLORADO DEPARTMENT OF STATE v. Micheal BACA

opinions.text: Petitioner in No. 19-465 and respondent in No. 19-518 shall file opening and reply briefs on the merits under the schedule set forth in Rules 25.1 and 25.3. Respondent in No. 19-465 and petitioner in No. 19-518 shall file response briefs on the merits under the schedule set forth in Rule 25.2.
